eyebrow: Half the picture is the query
code:
-- Looks fine as a CREATE TABLE
CREATE TABLE Orders (OrderId INT PRIMARY KEY, ...)

-- But the app does this on every page load:
SELECT * FROM Orders WHERE CustomerId = @id  -- x1
SELECT * FROM OrderLines WHERE OrderId = @o  -- xN, once per order
caption: A normalized schema can still be an N+1 pattern in production.
